Method of Attack: Hacking poorly protected WordPress sites to add heavily obfuscated JavaScript payload displaying fake Cloudflare DDoS protection screen
Downloading and running a 'security_install.iso' file disguised as a DDoS bypass tool
Executing a chain of scripts that install NetSupport RAT (remote access trojan) and Raccoon Stealer password-stealing trojan
Raccoon Stealer steals passwords, cookies, auto-fill data, credit cards, cryptocurrency wallets, performs file exfiltration and screenshots
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running the security_install.exe shortcut
Attack Vector: Compromised WordPress theme files with injected JavaScript
User interaction to download and open malicious ISO file
PowerShell command execution via Windows shortcut
Indicators of Compromise: File named 'security_install.exe' inside ISO acting as Windows shortcut
Injected malicious JavaScript in WordPress theme files such as jquery.min.js
Fake Cloudflare DDoS protection screen prompting user interaction
